WITH behavior_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    t.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_distinct_mixes
  FROM behavior_transactions
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    bt.ordertypedist as mix,
    bt.count,
    bt.count * 1.0 / t.total_count as share,
    1.0 / t.num_distinct_mixes as avg_share
  FROM behavior_transactions bt
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  mix,
  count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;
